seo.title: Send a parcel to Africa with a verified traveller
seo.description: Send a parcel to Dakar, Abidjan, Bamako or Douala with a verified traveller: a negotiated price, payment held until delivery and real-time tracking.

sender.title: Send a parcel to Africa with someone you can trust
sender.lead: Find a verified traveller already heading to your city, agree on a price, and follow your parcel right into your loved one's hands.

steps.title: Find a trip, or post your request
steps.text: On the map or in the list, filter by date, price, kilos or rating. No traveller on your dates? Post a shipping request, choose "I'm open to offers" or "I set my price", and let travellers come to you.

steps.title: Choose someone verified
steps.text: Every traveller has verified their identity. You can see their rating, their deliveries, their checks and what they agree to carry.

steps.title: Negotiate the price
steps.text: Take the listed price, or suggest your own. Offer, counter-offer: the conversation stays in the app until you reach a deal.

steps.title: Pay, and the money is held
steps.text: Card, mobile money or Yadony wallet. The amount is held until delivery: the traveller only gets paid once your loved one has the parcel.

steps.title: Hand over the parcel in person
steps.text: The traveller checks the contents in front of you, scans the parcel's QR code and takes a photo. You receive the pickup code to pass on to the recipient.

steps.title: Track it in real time
steps.text: Handed over, in the air, arrived: every step is time-stamped. Share the tracking link and your loved one can follow along without installing the app.

steps.title: Delivery against the code
steps.text: Your loved one gives their 6-digit code to the traveller. Delivery is confirmed, the payment is released, and you rate the traveller.

video.label: Video tutorial: sending a parcel with the Yadony app

faq.question: I can't find a traveller on my dates. What should I do?
faq.answer: Post a shipping request: route, weight, photos and budget. Travellers flying your route see it and make you an offer. You can also set an alert on your route to hear as soon as a traveller posts a trip.

faq.question: Can I negotiate the price?
faq.answer: Yes, if the traveller accepts price offers. You suggest an amount, and they can accept, decline or make a counter-offer. Some travellers show a fixed price: you either take it or choose someone else.

faq.question: How do I pay, and when does the traveller get paid?
faq.answer: By card, mobile money (Wave, Orange Money, MTN, Moov) or Yadony wallet. The amount is held until delivery and is only paid out to the traveller after the handover against the code. Cash is possible if the traveller accepts it, but without the held payment.

faq.question: Does my recipient need to install the app?
faq.answer: No. They track the parcel on a web page, with no account. On handover day, they give the traveller the 6-digit code you passed on to them.

seo.title: Sell your luggage space and make your trip to Africa pay
seo.description: Flying to Africa? Sell your spare baggage allowance to verified senders: per kilo, open to offers or per item, with payment held and released on delivery.

traveler.title: Sell your kilos, make your trip pay
traveler.lead: Your suitcase leaves with room to spare. Post your trip, set your price and carry parcels for verified senders: you get paid on delivery.

steps.title: Post your trip in three steps
steps.text: Route, places and capacity, price and conditions. Plane, car or boat, with stopovers or several legs. What you accept and what you turn down: you decide.

steps.title: Choose how you price
steps.text: A price per kilo, a price open to offers from senders, or a price list per item: phone, laptop, box of clothes.

steps.title: Share your poster
steps.text: Yadony creates a poster of your trip with its own QR code. Share it on WhatsApp and social media: your contacts book straight in the app.

steps.title: Get requests, negotiate
steps.text: Senders book or suggest a price. You accept, decline with a reason or make a counter-offer. You can also offer your price on their shipping requests.

steps.title: Scan at handover, even offline
steps.text: You check the contents, scan the QR code and take a photo. No signal at the airport? The scan is saved and sent as soon as you are back online.

steps.title: Arrived: let the recipients know
steps.text: One tap to mark your arrival, then WhatsApp, text, call or in-app message to arrange each handover.

steps.title: Deliver against the code, get paid
steps.text: The recipient gives you their 6-digit code: delivery is confirmed and the payment is sent to you, to your bank account or by mobile money.

earnings.title: What your kilos could earn you
earnings.text: 15 spare kg at 8 € per kilo comes to 120 € on a trip you are making anyway. And you set the price.
earnings.note: Example for illustration only: every traveller sets their own price.

payouts.title: Paid the way you want
payouts.text: Bank transfer to your account, or mobile money payout (Orange Money, Wave, MTN, Moov) in West and Central Africa. Keep track of your earnings and kilos sold in "My statistics".

faq.question: How much can I earn by selling my kilos?
faq.answer: You set the price, per kilo, per item or by negotiating. For example, 15 spare kg at 8 € per kilo earns you 120 €. Yadony takes its service fee from the sender's payment: the amount you will receive is shown before you accept.

faq.question: Do I have to accept every parcel?
faq.answer: No. You state what you accept and what you turn down, you see the description and photos of each parcel, and you check the contents at handover. You can decline a request with a reason.

faq.question: When do I get paid?
faq.answer: As soon as the recipient gives you their 6-digit code on delivery. The sender's payment has been held since the booking: you know the money is there before you even set off.

faq.question: What happens if I have no signal?
faq.answer: The QR code scan and the photo work offline. They are saved on your phone and sent automatically as soon as you are back online.

seo.title: Cheap flights to Africa: price alerts with Yadony
seo.description: Find cheap flights to Africa, to Dakar, Abidjan, Bamako or Douala: deals, price alerts and flights within your budget, all in the Yadony app.

flights.title: Your cheaper flight, without watching the prices
flights.lead: Set your maximum price and Yadony keeps an eye on flights for you. As soon as one drops below it, you will know.

steps.title: Search for your flight
steps.text: One way or return, number of passengers, direct flights only if you prefer. Results can be sorted from cheapest to fastest.

steps.title: Spot the deals
steps.text: "Deals for you" highlights flights that are much cheaper than usual on your routes.

steps.title: Set a price alert
steps.text: Your route, your dates or a time window, your maximum price. Yadony watches the flights so you don't have to.

steps.title: Get the flights under your price
steps.text: A notification, then the "Flights found" screen: the flights within your budget, with how much each one saves against your price.

steps.title: Book, then sell your kilos
steps.text: You book with our partner in a single tap. And since you are flying anyway, post your trip: your spare kilos can pay back part of the ticket.

flights.partnerNote: Yadony does not sell tickets: the app finds flights and alerts you, and you book on our partner's website.

sellKilos.title: Your ticket can partly pay for itself
sellKilos.text: With 15 spare kg at 8 € per kilo, your kilos earn you 120 €. Post your trip as soon as your ticket is booked.

faq.question: How does a price alert work?
faq.answer: You enter your route, your dates or a time window, and your maximum price. Yadony checks the available flights and sends you a notification as soon as one drops below that price. You will find your alerts in "My alerts".

faq.question: Does Yadony sell plane tickets?
faq.answer: No. Yadony finds flights and alerts you. Booking happens on our partner's website, which issues your ticket.

faq.question: Do the alerts cost anything?
faq.answer: No, flight search and price alerts are included in the app, with up to 10 active alerts at a time.

faq.question: Can I search for direct flights only?
faq.answer: Yes. Tick "Direct only" in the search, or sort the results with the "Direct" tab.
